files.rationale: Both PRs added the same MAX_USERNAME_LENGTH constant and identical length checks in ensureUserExists and handleCreateUser, so a single copy is kept (PR B's 30-character limit with its more informative log and error messages) to avoid a duplicate const declaration and redundant checks.

Both PRs wrap the username in a 120px max-width truncating span, so the merged span keeps the shared truncation styles plus PR A's align-bottom and PR B's title attribute that shows the full username on hover.
